correctness.rationale: Rank-one multiplication leaves just consecutive overlaps of residual lines, which in complex dimension two have the same moduli as those of the original unit vectors. The gaps are b^j, yielding precisely N factors after N+1 measurements. If the orbit does not tend to 0, a fixed compact set away from 0 is visited infinitely often and contributes a uniformly contracting factor; if the orbit tends to 0, its short signed representatives obey y_(j+1)=b y_j eventually, so boundedness implies an exact zero representative. At a b-adic phase no factor vanishes: an odd-denominator orbit cannot hit the balanced half-turn. If the balanced orbit does hit the half-turn the algorithm terminates and is correctly excluded only from the nonzero-factor category statement. Almost-everywhere averaging is valid because the balanced log-cosine singularity is locally integrable and the preimages of its zero are null; Jensen's integral gives the stated mass maximum. For each root-rate threshold and starting horizon the two open unions are dense by dense preimages of the two fixed points. Intersect these unions and the complements of the respective countable exceptional sets. For dimension, average log loss approaching zero forces a prefix with at most eps N orbit positions at distance at least b^(-2); every good position forces an adjacent pair 00 or (b-1)(b-1). Fixing the bad positions leaves at most b choices at each bad pair, no choices at a good pair once its first digit is fixed, and b initial choices. The entropy bound and convergent Hausdorff cover prove dimension zero for the entire upper-endpoint set including rational separations, not just the residual oscillation subset. The O(k)-length paired blocks have O(k^2) total length, so last partial blocks have negligible cost, yielding frequency p at every large horizon and negligible fixed-width boundaries. Square-position nonzero digits similarly give average zero for the bounded log potential, while avoiding an eventually constant zero or (b-1) tail. Reviewed the diagnostic without executing the attachment: its 537 checks are 420 matrix comparisons and 117 other checks, not a certification of the infinite claims. Its long floating-point orbit is a finite-precision sanity check, not evidence of the exact orbit of sqrt(2)-1.

value.rationale: The sampling model is naturally derived from ordinary Fourier recovery but loses stationarity. It gives a precise benchmark where exact failure is a dense countable arithmetic set; successful separations are typically exponentially convergent in measure but can have zero asymptotic log contraction rate and are category-typical at extreme subsequences. Decoupling recovery from a rate-one upper limit, with a dimension-zero certificate valid also for balanced masses, is a useful sharp distinction not available from finite horizon experiments.
